appointments.label: Appointments
appointments.description: Let your AI check the calendar and book callers into open slots, then manage those bookings.

leads.label: Leads
leads.description: Capture sales enquiries from calls as leads your team can follow up later.

quotes.label: Quotes
quotes.description: Price up work, send quotes customers accept online, and log quote requests from calls.

jobs.label: Jobs
jobs.description: Log on-site work your AI takes over the phone and schedule the visit.

invoices.label: Invoices
invoices.description: Raise invoices for completed work and track what's been paid.

callbacks.label: Callbacks
callbacks.description: Schedule a return call when your AI can't help the caller on the spot.

lookup_contact.label: Look up caller
lookup_contact.description: Check whether the caller is a known contact and greet them by name.

save_contact_info.label: Save contact info
save_contact_info.description: Save the caller's name, email, or company to their contact record.

add_to_dnc.label: Do-not-call requests
add_to_dnc.description: Add the caller to the do-not-call list when they ask.

get_current_time.label: Current time
get_current_time.description: Tell the time and whether the business is open right now.

get_call_history.label: Call history
get_call_history.description: Recall the caller's previous calls with any of your agents, with notes and transcripts.

schedule_callback.label: Schedule callback
schedule_callback.description: Book a future call back to the caller at a time they request.

check_availability.label: Check availability
check_availability.description: Find open appointment slots on the calendar.

book_appointment.label: Book appointment
book_appointment.description: Book the caller into an open appointment slot.

cancel_appointment.label: Cancel appointment
cancel_appointment.description: Cancel an existing appointment for the caller.

create_lead.label: Create lead
create_lead.description: Record a new sales lead from the conversation.

request_quote.label: Request quote
request_quote.description: Log a quote request for work the caller wants priced; the team quotes it afterwards.

create_job.label: Create job
create_job.description: Log a new job request from the caller.

check_job_availability.label: Check job availability
check_job_availability.description: Find open slots for scheduling a job visit.

book_job.label: Book job
book_job.description: Book a job visit into an open slot.

appointment_setter.label: Appointment setter
appointment_setter.description: Books, checks, and cancels appointments for callers.

after_hours.label: After hours

outbound_caller.label: Outbound caller
outbound_caller.description: Dials contacts for campaigns, callbacks, and follow-ups.

lead_qualifier.label: Lead qualifier
lead_qualifier.description: Calls new leads, qualifies interest, and records details.
